summary: Ford's concrete actions position him as a defender of Israel: in November 2023 he announced his office would send tactical gear to the IDF and pledged to ensure the Jewish community feels safe in Nevada. His October 2023 joint statement with 13 other state AGs denounced Hamas strikes, and a 2024 financial disclosure showed his 2023 travel to Israel, among other countries, was funded by the Attorney General Alliance. His campaign platform raises no Palestine or Gaza issue.
